Pools & slides Aquapark, kids splash park, infinity pool and an outdoor heated pool. Rooms & suites From new swim-up rooms to the 80 m² Family Suite. With its top-rated 5 star resort facilities for land and water activities, sports options, world-class spa, inspired local and international cuisine and the lively atmosphere of day and night entertainment, Titanic Deluxe Lara in Antalya offers endless opportunities for relaxation and recreation. FAQ What restaurants are included? / Are à la carte restaurants included? Parkfora Main Restaurant and Stella Beach Snack Restaurant is included. À la Carte restaurants are not included, reservation is required and cover charges apply. Is halal food served at the hotel? Yes, halal food is served at all food and beverage facilities at Titanic Deluxe Lara. When's the best time for the sea? Summer season usually starts by April until the en of October. Most preffered time is between May and August for swimming. Is a means of transport needed to get to the beach? / Is the beach next to the hotel? No, transportation is not needed to get to the beach. Titanic Deluxe Lara is located by the Mediterrenean Sea and it has a private beach by walking distance within the property. Is there a heated pool in winter season? Yes, there are indoor heated swimming pools for adults and kids separately and also an outdoor semi-olympic heated pool is available. Pools are heated during winter season however may change due to weather conditions. Are the pools, spa, kids club and restaurants open all year-round? In summer season all facilities are open. In winter SPA, fitness, kids club, heated pools and selected restaurants are open however some of the facilities are closed. For detailed information you may check the hotel's concepts . Does the all inclusive concept include alcohol? Yes, selected import and export alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages are included. A list of beverages can be found on the hotel’s concept file . Is air conditioning available in the rooms? All the rooms in our hotel are equipped with a central A/C system, which is automatically adjusted depending on the seasons; set to heat in the winter months and set to cool in the summer. Is there an iron in the rooms? No, there is no iron in the rooms however dry cleaning, laundry and ironing service is available at an extra cost. Is there a babysitter at the hotel? No, there is no babysitter at Titanic Deluxe Lara. At the Tini Kids Club there are different programs for all children of 04 -12 ages. Children under 4 years old should be accompanied with one of their parents. Is Cabana free to use? No, Cabanas at the Beach and the Swimming-Pools along with special daytime services are chargeable and reservation is required. To book your special Cabana you may contact us directly. Do you have hookah service at the hotel? Hookah service is provided at Titanic Deluxe Lara and is chargeable. I made an online booking, how can I pay? We request upfront payment of the first night's amount as soon as you make the booking. Send Direct Reservation +90 444 64 23 RESERVATION About Regnum Carya We design luxury with responsibility. In Belek / Antalya, we combine an elegant, understated, nature-inspired luxury all-inclusive experience with transparent management and a sustainability-driven approach. With a culture that redesigns the guest experience every day, we aim to deliver comfort, trust, and impact to the same standard. Our Story The story of Regnum Hotels is far more than a single concept of “accommodation.” It began with the pursuit of bringing together the rhythm of nature, the quiet intelligence of design, and the refinement of service within the same vision. Everything was shaped by the passion for golf of Regnum’s Honorary President, Mr. Fikret Öztürk, who played the sport with dedication for many years. Inspired by the elegance and discipline of golf, this passion led to the establishment of Carya Golf Club in 2007. Regnum entered the world of golf not merely as an investment, but with a true sense of belonging. Over time, accommodation requests from golfers and the growing needs of the region expanded Regnum’s vision. What began as a need transformed into a powerful commitment to hospitality with the opening of Regnum Carya in Belek in 2014. Since its opening, Regnum Carya has been more than a hotel, it has become a stage for life, hosting internationally recognized events and inspiring experiences. Hosting the G20 Summit, welcoming world-famous stars on stage, and creating unforgettable moments for every guest… Over the years, Regnum has delivered major global events while redefining service excellence time and again. A new era began in 2025, marking the culmination of this ten-year journey: Regnum The Crown. Designed to elevate our heritage of service to new heights, Regnum The Crown offers a unique world through its distinguished architecture, exclusive experiences, and refined approach to accommodation. At Regnum Hotels, every detail has the same purpose: To offer our guests not only a stay, but a lasting “Regnum feeling” they will remember with every return. Mission & Vision Our Mission: To deliver luxury by combining elegance, simplicity, and nature in peaceful and enjoyable environments created for guests of all ages and cultures, and to leave unforgettable impressions through a service approach that exceeds expectations. Our Vision: To become a global brand that is the first choice of guests, employees, and all stakeholders; distinguished by its unique guest experience; continuously improving itself while contributing to the development and brand value of its region. Our Values We see our values not as “statements on a wall,” but as decisions we repeat every day: Visionary mindset: Offering innovative, original, inspiring services that create value for the sector. Respect for nature and the environment: Embracing sustainability in every area within our nature-inspired properties. Valuing people: Building both employee and guest experience on a foundation of safety, peace, and support. Sincerity: Creating lasting, warm, fair relationships through genuine care and satisfaction. Pursuit of excellence: Continuously developing and improving through teamwork. Our Luxury Experience Philosophy For us, luxury is not about extravagance, it is about flawless flow. Our perspective, focused on exceeding guest expectations, is built on continuously measuring and improving service quality and guest satisfaction. We bring this philosophy to life through a holistic language that includes gastronomy, wellness and sports facilities, year-round experience design, and safe and comfortable living spaces. Our Sustainability Strategy We do not consider corporate sustainability a “side project,” but an integral part of how we do business. Regnum Hotels openly states its commitment to increasing social impact and reducing environmental impact by 2030, and transparently integrates this approach into the guest experience. Governance, Ethics & Compliance Our ethical approach is defined through principles such as respect for human rights, legal compliance, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, prevention of conflicts of interest, confidentiality and protection of internal information, donations/sponsorship, competition law compliance, and maintaining a healthy and safe working environment. Pools On a fantastic summer day, soothe your sun-warmed skin in the cool waters of the pools or indulge in the year-round swimming in heated pools. Maldives Pool Transporting you to the South Asian coasts, the Maldives Pool creates an exotic ambiance with its towering palm trees and pristine white sands. Main Pool The largest pool at Maxx Royal Belek caters to the expectations of swimming enthusiasts. Heated in Seasonal Transitions Kids' Pool Little ones have a splashing good time in the heated kids’ pool during seasonal transitions. Heated in Seasonal Transitions Seawater Pool The heated pool, filled with seawater, provides a swimming experience that rivals the sea for enthusiasts. For Adults Deep Pool Calling all diving enthusiasts and professional swimmers, the 2-meter-deep pool is ready for your enjoyment. Lagoon Pool For a tranquil and restful swim, the Lagoon Pool is the perfect choice, being situated far from any noise. Terrace Pool The Terrace Pool, dedicated to guests staying in the Terrace Family Suite and Terrace Laguna Family Suite, provides an enjoyable setting with its scenic view of nature. Terrace Kids' Pool The Terrace Kids' Pool caters to the little guests staying with their families in the Terrace Family Suite and Terrace Laguna Family Suite. Indoor Pool The indoor pool situated in the Maxx Wellbeing Spa area enhances the swimming experience with its serene atmosphere.
